title.zh: 将陆路运输办公室乌尔达内塔分区办事处升格为A类分区办事处，并将其更名为陆路运输办公室比纳洛南分区办事处的法案
title.en: An Act Converting the Land Transportation Office Urdaneta District Office Into a Class ‘A’ District Office, Renaming the Same as the Land Transportation Office Binalonan District Office and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Converting the Land Transportation Office Urdaneta District Office Into a Class ‘A’ District Office, Renaming the Same as the Land Transportation Office Binalonan District Office and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật nâng cấp Văn phòng Khu vực Cơ quan Vận tải Đường bộ Urdaneta thành Văn phòng Khu vực loại ‘A’ và đổi tên thành Văn phòng Khu vực Cơ quan Vận tải Đường bộ Binalonan
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติปรับสถานะสำนักงานเขตสำนักการขนส่งทางบกอูร์ดาเนตาเป็นสำนักงานเขตชั้น ‘เอ’ และเปลี่ยนชื่อเป็นสำนักงานเขตสำนักการขนส่งทางบกบินาโลนัน
title.id: Undang-Undang Menaikkan Kantor Distrik Kantor Transportasi Darat Urdaneta menjadi Kantor Distrik Kelas ‘A’ dan Mengganti Namanya menjadi Kantor Distrik Kantor Transportasi Darat Binalonan
title.ms: Akta Meningkatkan Tahap Pejabat Daerah Jabatan Pengangkutan Jalan Raya Urdaneta kepada Kelas ‘A’ dan Menukar Namanya kepada Pejabat Daerah Jabatan Pengangkutan Jalan Raya Binalonan

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2025/ra_12130_2025.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The existing Land Transportation Office (LTO) District Office in Urdaneta City, Pangasinan (LTO Urdaneta District Office) is hereby converted into a Class "A" LTO district office and renamed as the LTO Binalonan District Office.

The Secretary of the Department of Transportation shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the LTO Binalonan District Office in the Fifth District of Pangasinan, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriation of the LTO Urdaneta District Office. Thereafter, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriation Act.
This Act shall take effect after fifteen (15) days following the completion of its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
